> 第25章 复仇之剑（第1页）
徐鸣一怔，很快想到什么意识过来：“师傅……”
张云不是正与林家金丹期战斗吗，怎么……
看向徐鸣的左肩伤口，此时已经几近愈合完全，刚刚刺在上面的金匕首也消失不见。
随着徐鸣实力增长，其体内暂时被激活的变异赤金龙灵根也愈发活跃，能够直接将金质物转化为金属性能量吸收入体内，转化为其自身能量。
这意思是，张云已经将林家的金丹期给解决了？
眼角忽然瞥到旁边林世二人，徐鸣双眼骤凝，怒火与恨意一下间涌现而出：“林世！！”
张云一怔，问：“鸣儿，你认识这两人？”
徐鸣点头，咬牙切齿道：“就是他们夺了我灵根，杀了我父母！！”
张云眉头一扬，一时明白过来：“这么说，他们是冲着你来的？”
闻言，徐鸣满脸歉意：“是我连累……”
没给其说完，张云直接打断：“在为师面前，不要说什么对不起。从你拜我为师那一刻起，你的事那就是为师的事！”
顿了顿，张云看向林世二人：“为师先前就在奇怪，是谁要对我们师徒下手，现在总算弄明白了！”
看到他走过来，林世二人都是脸色一变，屁股连连向后蠕动。
“鸣儿，既是你的仇人，那就交给你吧！”
张云顿住脚步，将刚刚斩了那两位金丹期的剑，递给了徐鸣。
徐鸣接过剑，看向林世眼中充满恨意，咬牙一步跨上前。
“徐鸣，本少可是林家少主。你不能杀我，若杀了我，你和你师傅都将遭到我林家不死不休的报复！！”
林世见他迟疑，连忙趁热打铁：“徐鸣，只要现在你们立刻放了本少二人，本少可既往不……唔！”

话到一半便戛然而止，只见徐鸣已是举起剑，一剑直接刺入了他胸口。
“这一剑，是为我自己的。我当年瞎了眼，竟然会把你当作好友！”
徐鸣沉声说着，从对方胸口猛地将剑拔出，然后……
“这一剑，还是为我自己。你剥夺我龙灵根，让我一夜间变成废人，此仇我记在这一剑下！”
徐鸣冷冷说着，再次抽出剑刃，然后一剑对准林世的心脏刺了进去。

> Chapter 25 Sword of Vengeance (Page 1)
Xu Ming was startled and quickly realized something: "Master..."
Isn't Zhang Yun fighting with the Lin family's Jindanqi? Why...
Looking at Xu Ming's left shoulder wound, it was almost completely healed, and the golden dagger that had just been stabbed on it had disappeared.
As Xu Ming's strength increased, the mutated red gold dragon spirit root that was temporarily activated in his body also became more active. It could directly convert gold objects into metallic energy and absorb it into the body, converting it into its own energy.
This means that Zhang Yun has solved the Lin family's golden elixir stage?
Suddenly he caught sight of Lin Shi and two people next to him from the corner of his eyes. Xu Ming's eyes suddenly condensed, and anger and hatred suddenly emerged: "Lin Shi!!"
Zhang Yun was startled and asked: "Ming'er, do you know these two people?"
Xu Ming nodded, gritted his teeth and said, "They were the ones who took away my spiritual roots and killed my parents!!"
Zhang Yun raised his brows and understood for a moment: "So, they are here for you?"
Hearing this, Xu Ming apologized: "I was the one who was involved..."
Before he could finish his words, Zhang Yun interrupted directly: "Don't say sorry in front of my teacher. From the moment you become my teacher, your business is my teacher's business!"
After a pause, Zhang Yun looked at Lin Shi and the two of them: "I was wondering before, as my master, who wanted to attack our master and disciple, but now I finally understand!"
Seeing him coming over, both Lin Shi's expressions changed, and their buttocks squirmed backwards.
"Ming'er, since I'm your enemy, I'll leave it to you!"
Zhang Yun paused and handed the sword that had just beheaded the two Jin Danqi to Xu Ming.
Xu Ming took the sword, looked at Lin Shi with hatred in his eyes, gritted his teeth and stepped forward.
"Xu Ming, I am the young master of the Lin family. You cannot kill me. If you kill me, both you and your master will suffer unending revenge from my Lin family!!"
Seeing his hesitation, Lin Shi quickly struck while the iron was hot: "Xu Ming, as long as you let me and the two of you go immediately, I won't let bygones be bygones... huh!"
The words stopped abruptly, and Xu Ming was seen raising his sword, and the sword pierced directly into his chest.
"This sword is for myself. I was blind back then, but I actually regarded you as a good friend!"
Xu Ming said in a deep voice, suddenly pulled out the sword from the opponent's chest, and then...
"This sword is for myself. You deprived me of my dragon spirit root and turned me into a useless person overnight. I will bear this revenge with this sword!"
Xu Ming said coldly, drew out the sword blade again, then aimed the sword at Lin Shi's heart and stabbed it in.
